text_detail_en: I work as a data analyst whose practice sits at the intersection of Applied Research, measurement, and everyday decision support. Day to day I turn messy operational and experiential signals into structured evidence: advanced Excel (formulas, VBA, database-style workbooks, shortcuts), CSV pipelines, Power BI, Python and SQL, plus both descriptive and inferential statistics. Master's coursework in Information Visualization (Grade A) shapes how I choose visual structure and interaction for stakeholders. I use CSI and NPS deliberately to prioritize outcomes, not vanity metrics. I am completing a Master's in Technology (September 2026) with Grade A across all courses so far. Outside work I practice the art of memory with mnemonics and memory palaces, and I build AutoHotkey, Python, and other macros so the computer itself becomes quieter and faster under my hands.

text_detail_pt: Atuo como analista de dados na interseção entre Pesquisa Aplicada, medição e apoio à decisão do dia a dia.
